name: Imperial Iran

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of green, white and red, with a gold lion holding a curved sword in front of a rising sun in the center of the white stripe.
flag.symbolism: The lion and sun had been an emblem of Iran for centuries, combining old Persian symbols of royalty and the sun.

hook: Imperial Iran is green-white-red with a gold sword-carrying lion before a rising sun; the Islamic Republic swapped it for a red emblem and white script, and Tajikistan reverses the colors.
trivia: After the 1979 revolution the lion and sun was removed, and the current emblem was adopted in 1980.
The lion-and-sun flag is still widely flown by Iranians abroad and by opponents of the Islamic Republic.
